title: StrataPlan
description: The plan deposited in the Land Title Office that divides land or a building into strata lots and common property.
x-validationRules: totalStrataLots should equal the number of StrataLot records for the plan in a complete data set.
totalUnitEntitlement should equal the sum of StrataLot.unitEntitlement in a complete data set.
x-legalReviewNotes: Confirm whether additional plan types (for example, mixed building and bare land) need to be represented.

id.description: Stable identifier of this StrataPlan record.

x-enumDescriptions.building: Strata lots are defined by reference to a building.
x-enumDescriptions.bareLand: Strata lots are defined by reference to land rather than a building.

depositDate.description: Date the plan was deposited in the Land Title Office.

totalStrataLots.description: Number of strata lots on the plan.

totalUnitEntitlement.description: Sum of unit entitlement of all strata lots, from the Schedule of Unit Entitlement.

phased.description: Whether the plan was or is being deposited in phases.

amendments.description: Recorded amendments to the strata plan.

extensions.description: Implementation-specific data, namespaced by reverse domain.
